title: Best *OP* Auto Get Brainrot Rarity Pick Tween Speed
features:
Join our Discord server for support, bug reports, previews, suggestions, and more!

Features:

* Get Brainrot - Enabled, Searches For Selected Rarity And Runs You To It
* Rarity dropdown - Enabled, Common / Rare / Epic / Legendary / Mythic / Celestial / Secret
* Tween Speed slider - Enabled, Controls How Fast You Move Toward The Brainrot
* Auto Move to Target - Enabled, Steps Your HumanoidRootPart Toward The Found SpawnedItem
* Manual Pickup Prompt - Enabled, Tells You To Pick It Up Once You Arrive
* Auto TP to Safe Zone after confirmed pickup - Enabled, Teleports To SpawnLocation And Notifies When Ready Again
* No-Collide while running - Enabled, Forces CanCollide Off So You Don'T Get Stuck
* +1 / +5 / +10 Speed Upgrades - Enabled, Fires PurchaseSpeed
* Purchase Carry - Enabled, Fires PurchaseCarry
* Infinite Jump - Enabled, Toggle
* Long Jump - Enabled, Toggle
* Long Jump Power slider - Enabled, Forward Boost Strength
